payload.explanation: The target surface 士龍 (Shilong) is the courtesy name of 陸雲 (Lu Yun), the younger brother of 陸機 (Lu Ji). The Liu Xiaobiao annotation (annotation-007) explicitly states that 士龍 was the fifth son of 吳大司馬抗 (Lu Kang) and the younger full brother of 陸機, and annotation-009 further identifies 陸士龍 as 陸雲. The main text evidence in story 08-shangyu-020 pairs 陸士衡 (Lu Ji) with 士龍, and the parallel evidence from 05-fangzheng-018, 08-shangyu-039, and 25-paidiao-009 all consistently use 士龍 to refer to 陸雲 (Lu Yun), the brother of 陸機. The claimed person hdb1-person-759b52a33b9c2b8d3a934fdd is correctly identified as 陸雲 via the courtesy name 士龍. The candidate alternative surface 士龍 is the same surface, so no alternative is proposed. The identification is well-supported by explicit annotation and consistent cross-story usage.

The target surface "仲文" in story 09-pinzao-045 is being claimed to refer to 朱伺 (Zhu Si). However, the supplied evidence from multiple other sources (Liu annotations and main texts from stories 28-chumian-009 and 04-wenxue-099) consistently identifies "仲文" as 殷仲文 (Yin Zhongwen), a well-known figure of the Eastern Jin period. The Liu annotation in 28-chumian-009 explicitly states "仲文後為東陽" and "仲文甞照鏡", and the main text of that story describes 殷仲文's career as 東陽太守. The annotation in 04-wenxue-099 also refers to 仲文's literary talents. There is no evidence in any supplied passage connecting "仲文" to 朱伺. The claim that 仲文 refers to 朱伺 appears to be a misattribution — the surface "仲文" is a courtesy name (字) of 殷仲文, not of 朱伺. The evidence from the flagged story itself (hda2-ev-a33bd4c00cb39c163ecc) provides insufficient context to identify who 仲文 is, but the corroborating evidence from other stories clearly establishes that 仲文 = 殷仲文.

The supplied evidence contains the surface "干寳" appearing in the text, but the surrounding context is fragmentary and does not provide sufficient information to independently confirm that "干寳" refers to the claimed person (干寳). The evidence passage is a partial excerpt from a larger narrative about 王經, and while 干寳 (Gan Bao) is a known historical figure who wrote the 晉紀 (as referenced in annotation-006), the supplied evidence alone does not provide enough contextual grounding to definitively verify the identity claim. The annotation-006 does mention "傅畼干寳所記" which suggests 干寳 as a recorder/author, but this is from the annotation layer rather than the primary evidence passage. Given the limited context, the evidence is insufficient to either confirm or reject the identification.

The target surface "蘇子高" appears in the main text of Shishuo Xinyu, chapter 方正第五, story 05-fangzheng-037. The Liu Xiaobiao annotation (hda2-ev-2b98a829eb692f5a8d4d) explicitly references "蘇峻事" in connection with this story, identifying the person behind the surface "蘇子高" as 蘇峻. "子高" is the courtesy name (字) of 蘇峻, and the annotation directly links the event described (蘇子高事平) to 蘇峻's rebellion. The annotation in story 05-fangzheng-036 (hda2-ev-44dfa088a43e81808658) also confirms 蘇峻 as the historical figure involved in the rebellion against 庾亮, consistent with the context of the flagged story. The evidence explicitly grounds the identity of 蘇子高 as 蘇峻 through the Liu annotation's explicit reference.

The target surface 謝鯤 appears in the story where 王敦 is 大將軍 stationed at 豫章, and the text explicitly states "于時謝鯤爲長史" — identifying 謝鯤 as the 長史 (chief clerk) under 王敦. This is consistent with the historical 謝鯤, who served as 長史 under 王敦. Additional evidence from other passages in the same work (世說新語) confirms 謝鯤 as 豫章太守 and as a person who mourned 衛玠, all consistent with the same historical figure. The context clearly identifies 謝鯤 as the person being addressed by 王敦 in the story, and there is no ambiguity or alternative person suggested by the evidence.

The target surface "王敦" in the story "桓温行經王敦墓邊過望之云可兒可兒" refers to the historical figure 王敦 (Wang Dun), the famous Eastern Jin general. The main text evidence (hda2-ev-706ca4056430387f616f) explicitly places 桓温 passing by 王敦's tomb, which is a well-known historical reference to Wang Dun. Additional evidence from other stories in the same work (hda2-ev-0ecf34e01bd0ce8f9510 and hda2-ev-d3f48596f4828f43c2f9) consistently refer to 王敦 as the same person — the general who killed 司馬愍王 and who was associated with 石崇. The Liu annotation (hda2-ev-f97a1e4ce4d2b246d708) also confirms 王敦 in the context of 武昌, which matches Wang Dun's historical role. There is no evidence suggesting a different person named 王敦 in this context, and the identification is consistent across multiple passages in the same work.

The target surface 謝鯤 appears in multiple independent passages from the 世說新語 (Shishuo Xinyu) main text, consistently referring to the same person. In the flagged story (10-guizhen-012), 謝鯤 is described as 豫章太守 (Grand Administrator of Yuzhang) accompanying 大將軍 (General-in-Chief, i.e., Wang Dun) to Stone Head, and is directly addressed by 敦 (Wang Dun). The same person 謝鯤 is also referenced in other stories: in 17-shangshi-006, 謝鯤 mourns the death of 衛洗馬 (Wei Jie); in 08-shangyu-051, 謝鯤 is identified as 長史 (Chief Clerk) under 王敦. These consistent contextual references across multiple stories confirm that 謝鯤 refers to the historical figure Xie Kun (謝鯤), the well-known Jin dynasty official. There is no evidence suggesting the surface refers to a different person, and no alternative surface is proposed. The claim should be retained.

The target surface "謝安石" appears in the story where 桓公 (桓溫) sees 謝安石's draft of 簡文諡議. The known local participants list identifies 謝安 (person-006) with the surface "安石" in this same story. The story text itself uses "安石" as a coreferential short form for "謝安石" ("此是安石碎金"), confirming that 謝安石 and 安石 refer to the same person. Additionally, other evidence passages (hda2-ev-bfa7c119c183f7d9af7d and hda2-ev-b9063d605f5fd974d3bb) explicitly use "謝安" in contexts involving 王坦之/王文度, matching the historical figure 謝安. The Liu annotation (hda2-ev-9ce5cb6d928f3c59f388) also mentions 謝安 in connection with 桓溫 and 簡文's death, corroborating the identity. The surface "謝安石" is a well-formed name form (given name + courtesy name) for 謝安, and the local coreference with "安石" in the same story confirms the identification.

The target surface 劉琨 appears in the Liu Xiaobiao annotation quoting 鄧粲晉紀, which explicitly names 劉琨 as the person who made a statement about someone (澄). The main text evidence from 世說正文 (02-yanyu-035 and 02-yanyu-036) consistently refers to 劉琨 as the historical figure Liu Kun, the Jin dynasty general and official who sent 温嶠 as an envoy to the south. The Liu annotation in 08-shangyu-043 also refers to 司空劉琨, confirming this is the same well-attested historical person. All evidence consistently points to the same individual — Liu Kun (劉琨), the Western Jin military leader. There is no evidence suggesting the surface refers to a different person, and the identification is consistent across multiple independent sources.

The main text of story 09-pinzao-088 explicitly states "舊以桓謙比殷仲文" — the person being compared to 殷仲文 is 桓謙, not 卞範之. The Liu annotation (annotation-001) identifies 謙 as 桓謙 (字敬祖, 沖第三子), providing the full name 桓謙. The claimed person 卞範之 (字敬祖) is a different person entirely — the annotation's "敬祖" refers to 桓謙's courtesy name, not 卞範之. The target surface "謙" in this story refers to 桓謙, and the alternative surface 桓謙 is the correct identification. The claimed person 卞範之 is a different named person.

The target surface 樂廣 appears in the main text of Shishuo Xinyu, story 01-dexing-023, where 樂廣 is explicitly named as the speaker who laughs and says "名教中自有樂地何為乃爾也." The same person 樂廣 is also referenced in story 08-shangyu-023, where 衛伯玉 praises 樂廣 as "此人人之水鏡也," and in the Liu annotation for 09-pinzao-007, where 樂廣 is mentioned alongside 裴頠 as someone who valued certain individuals. All evidence consistently points to the historical figure 樂廣 (Yue Guang), a well-known Jin dynasty figure. There is no contradicting evidence suggesting a different person or ambiguity. The claim should be retained.

The target surface 陸機 appears in the story "陸機詣王武子" (Lu Ji visits Wang Wuzi). The main text explicitly names 陸機 as the person visiting Wang Wuzi, and the story is about Lu Ji's famous remark about 千里蓴羹. Additionally, the corroborating evidence from 賞譽第八 (story 08-shangyu-039) explicitly identifies 陸機 (also referred to as 士衡) as the brother of 陸雲 (士龍), confirming that 陸機 is the well-known historical figure Lu Ji. The evidence clearly and explicitly grounds the surface 陸機 to the claimed person, and there is no contradicting evidence suggesting a different individual.

The target surface "伏滔" appears consistently across multiple independent passages in the 世說新語 (Shishuo Xinyu) referring to the same person. In the main text passages (22-chongli-002, 22-chongli-005, 26-qingdi-012), 伏滔 is consistently named alongside 袁宏 (袁虎) as a member of 桓公's staff, and in 22-chongli-005 he is explicitly identified as someone who attended a gathering at 西堂 with 孝武 (Emperor Xiaowu). The registered alias evidence (hda2-ev-5fbc1dd4dad881142d7d) also confirms this identification. All occurrences of "伏滔" in the supplied evidence refer to the same historical figure, the Jin dynasty official 伏滔, and there is no contradicting evidence suggesting a different person. The claim should be retained.

The target surface 孫安國 is the courtesy name (字) of 孫盛. Evidence hda2-ev-0463cd31e8c623dace5e shows 孫安國 in the story where he debates with 殷中軍 (殷浩), and the Liu annotation (hda2-ev-a14b0f32dfa92146cab5) explicitly identifies the person in this story as 孫盛, stating "孫盛善理義時中軍將軍殷浩擅" — directly linking 孫安國 in this story to 孫盛. Additionally, hda2-ev-ad9fc25479b4fd598df4 shows 孫安國 being asked about by name in a context where the person is referred to as 孫監 (孫盛 held the office of 監), and the Liu annotation (hda2-ev-c2d3f389dda2c2bcc1aa) explicitly glosses 孫盛 as the person referenced. The evidence clearly establishes that 孫安國 is the courtesy name of 孫盛, confirming the alias claim.

The target surface "袁公" appears in the story about 陳元方 (Chen Yuanfang) visiting 袁公, who is described as having previously served as 鄴令 (magistrate of Ye). This is a story from 政事 (Zhengshi) chapter about governance. The claimed person is 袁宏 (Yuan Hong), a Jin dynasty figure who appears in other passages (賞譽 and 寵禮 chapters) as a contemporary of 桓宣武 and author of 名士傳. The 袁公 in this story is clearly a different person — a Han-era official (the father of 陳元方 lived during the Eastern Han, and 袁公 was a contemporary magistrate). There is no evidence connecting 袁宏 to the title "袁公" in this story, and the context clearly indicates a different historical figure. The other evidence items mentioning 袁宏 are from entirely different stories and do not support identifying 袁公 as 袁宏.

The evidence directly establishes that 萬年 is the courtesy name (字) of 孟嘉. Evidence hda2-ev-079971371a15f0ea5436 explicitly states "嘉别傳曰嘉字萬年" (Jia's separate biography says: Jia's courtesy name is Wannian), providing an explicit identity assertion linking the target surface 萬年 to the claimed person 孟嘉. Additionally, evidence hda2-ev-dd044d4d1a70ebb3e3bc uses 孟萬年 as a compound reference to the same person, and the other evidence items (hda2-ev-8f52be70f4eba456dce4, hda2-ev-ca483909671f6f168915) consistently refer to 孟嘉 in the same narrative context. The identification of 萬年 as 孟嘉's courtesy name is explicit and well-supported, so the existing claim should be retained.

The target surface "王仲祖" appears in the story where the known local participant 王濛 is identified by the surface "仲祖" (his courtesy name). The story text uses "王仲祖" as the full form of the courtesy name for 王濛, and the known local participants list explicitly identifies 王濛 with the surface "仲祖" in this same story. The evidence passage hda2-ev-b55c94df92a56e92c6de (and its duplicate hda2-ev-bcd3dcfa0a886d61daa0) shows "王仲祖" acting alongside 謝仁祖 and 劉眞長, and the local coreference data confirms that "仲祖" refers to 王濛 in this story. The courtesy name "仲祖" is the style name of 王濛, so "王仲祖" (surname + courtesy name) refers to the same person. The claim that "王仲祖" refers to 王濛 is retained.

The target surface "王右軍" is a well-established title-based alias for 王羲之 (Wang Xizhi), who held the office of 右軍將軍 (General of the Right Army). The evidence shows this surface used consistently across multiple stories in the 世說新語 (Shishuo Xinyu), including the flagged occurrence where 謝太傅 (Xie An) addresses 王右軍. The registered alias evidence (hda2-ev-afc9a0f8980ef13850d5) explicitly grounds this surface as an alias for 王羲之. The other main-text passages also use "王右軍" in contexts consistent with 王羲之's identity (e.g., his wife 郄夫人, his interactions with the 謝 family, and his presence in the south as an official). There is no contradicting evidence suggesting the surface refers to anyone else. The title "右軍" is a distinctive office title held by 王羲之, making this a clear title-holder identification.

The target surface "山公" appears in the main text of Shishuo Xinyu story 07-shijian-004, where the same passage explicitly names "山濤" and later refers to him as "山公" and "山少傅" (山濤 held the title of 少傅). The Liu annotation for the same story (hda2-ev-4c783d04ebe38d741955) explicitly identifies the person as 山濤. Additionally, in the registered alias evidence (hda2-ev-8c607b2393fd0b23e0f5), "山公" is used to refer to 山濤 in the context of recommending 阮咸. The cross-referencing between the main text and Liu annotation confirms that "山公" is a courtesy/title-based alias for 山濤. No contradicting evidence exists.

The supplied evidence consists solely of the story text in which 劉令言 appears as the subject who enters Luoyang and comments on various famous figures. The claimed person is hdb1-person-7f2507eda887a44769cb4139, but the evidence passages provide no biographical details, identification, or contextual information that would confirm or refute that 劉令言 refers to this specific person. The only other known local participant is 樂廣 (樂彦輔), who is mentioned as someone the speaker respects, but this does not establish the identity of 劉令言. Without additional identifying information linking the surface 劉令言 to the claimed person, the evidence is insufficient to confirm or reject the identity claim.

The main text of Shishuo Xinyu, chapter 言語第二, story 02-yanyu-071, explicitly states "左將軍王凝之妻也" — identifying 王凝之 as the Left General (左將軍) and husband of Xie Daoyun (謝道韞), the daughter of Xie Wuyi (謝無奕). This is an explicit identity assertion within the source text itself. Additionally, the evidence from chapter 賢媛第十九 (19-xianyuan-026) corroborates 王凝之 as a distinct historical person, referred to as "王郎" and described as the son of 逸少 (Wang Xizhi). The candidate alternative surface 王凝之 is identical to the target surface, so no alternative is warranted. The claim is retained based on explicit textual identification.

The target surface "何次道" appears in the story "25-paidiao-022" where 何次道 visits 瓦官寺 and converses with 阮思曠. The registered alias evidence (hda2-ev-482ba0d9f0d2106fbf70) grounds "何次道" as an alias for 何充. Additionally, the main text evidence (hda2-ev-20a09a134100400135df) explicitly identifies 何充 in another Shishuo Xinyu story, confirming 何充 is a real person in the same work. "次道" is the courtesy name (字) of 何充, and the alias registration links the surface "何次道" to the claimed person 何充. The evidence is sufficient to retain the existing identity mapping.

The supplied evidence consists of a single short passage from 世說新語 (任誕第二十三, story 13) mentioning 阮渾. The text states that 阮渾 grew up with demeanor resembling his father and also wanted to act in a "達" (unrestrained) manner, and that 步兵 (referring to 阮籍) said that 仲容 (阮咸) already participated in that, so 阮渾 should not do so again. The passage identifies 阮渾 as the son of 步兵 (阮籍), and the claimed person is hdb1-person-06cb000a4f86e5d09baa018f. However, the evidence does not provide sufficient explicit identification linking the surface 阮渾 to the specific claimed person ID. The passage gives context about 阮渾 being 阮籍's son, but without additional biographical or genealogical information in the supplied evidence that explicitly confirms this 阮渾 is the same person as the claimed person ID, the evidence is insufficient to confirm or reject the identity claim. The passage is too brief and lacks explicit identity assertions connecting the surface to the claimed person.

The target surface 盧志 appears in the Shishuo Xinyu story 方正第五-018, where 盧志 is explicitly named as the person who asks 陸士衡 (陸機) about his father and grandfather (陸遜, 陸抗). The story directly identifies 盧志 as the interlocutor in this famous exchange. Additionally, in 尤悔第三十三-003, 盧志 is again named as the person who slandered 陸平原 (陸機), leading to his execution. Both passages consistently refer to the same historical figure 盧志, and the claimed person (hdb1-person-dc8d01b7f1c11ec7a6b5b5ce) is the correct referent for this surface. The evidence clearly supports retaining the existing identity assignment.

The evidence passage states: "(將軍伊少有才蓺又善聲律加以標悟省率爲王蒙/小字也續晉陽秋曰伊字叔夏譙國銍人父景護軍)". The passage explicitly identifies 王蒙 as the 小字 (childhood name) of 伊 (i.e., 桓伊, whose courtesy name is 叔夏). The claimed person is 王濛, but the evidence clearly indicates that the surface 王蒙 refers to a different person — it is the childhood name of 桓伊, not the person 王濛. The candidate alternative surface 王蒙 is proposed as the correct referent for this occurrence, since the text explicitly states 王蒙 is the 小字 of 伊 (桓伊).

The target surface 陸平原 appears in the Shishuo Xinyu text. The term "平原" is a well-known title/office designation (陸機 served as 平原內史), and the evidence from story 33-youhui-003 explicitly states "陸平原河橋敗為盧志所讒被誅" with the famous death lament about 華亭鶴唳, which is a well-documented biographical detail of 陸機 (Lu Ji). Additionally, in story 08-shangyu-019, 張華 addresses 陸平原 alongside 褚陶, and the context of "君兄弟龍躍雲津" refers to the famous Lu brothers (陸機 and 陸雲), confirming the identity. The evidence in 15-zixin-001 also mentions "二陸平原不在正見清河" where 清河 refers to 陸雲, further confirming 陸平原 as 陸機. The title-holder designation and explicit biographical details confirm the claimed person.

The target surface 仲智 appears in the story about 周伯仁 (周顗). The Liu annotation (hda2-ev-f8f84d0ea9a6cf221396) explicitly states "軍嵩字仲智謨兄也" — identifying 仲智 as the courtesy name (字) of 周嵩, who is the elder brother of 周謨 and thus a brother of 周顗 (周伯仁). The story context shows 仲智 arriving to visit the ailing 周伯仁, and the parallel story in 雅量第六 (hda2-ev-f8aa75ecc44d928c13d6) shows 周仲智 (i.e., 周嵩) interacting with 伯仁 as his brother. The claimed person hdb1-person-b64c433a6c463735c5af0ba3 is evidently 周嵩, and the surface 仲智 is his courtesy name. The evidence clearly supports retaining the existing identity assignment.

The target surface 王敦 in story 07-shijian-006 refers to the historical figure Wang Dun (王敦), the Grand General (大將軍). The main text evidence (hda2-ev-d774a0272cc794907bbe) shows 潘陽仲 seeing 王敦 as a child and making a prophecy about him, which is a well-known anecdote about Wang Dun. The Liu annotation (hda2-ev-e18d0fc1f94caa721143) explicitly connects 王敦 to the context of 中宗相州刺史 and the 晉陽秋 reference to 司馬丞, situating him in the historical record. Additional corroborating evidence from other stories (hda2-ev-45efcd934829b8346e85 and hda2-ev-d62357011143d11381d1) consistently refer to the same 王敦, the Grand General, confirming the identity. The relevant Liu annotation for this story (annotation-002) also mentions 王敦 being transferred to 楊州 by 東海王越, further confirming this is the historical Wang Dun. There is no contradicting evidence suggesting a different person.

The evidence strongly supports that the target surface 王敦 refers to the claimed person 王敦 (Wang Dun). The primary evidence from the 晉書 (Book of Jin), juan 98, explicitly identifies 王敦 as the subject of the biography, giving his courtesy name 處仲 and describing him as the cousin of 王導 (司徒導之從父兄也). The Shishuo Xinyu passages also consistently refer to 王敦 in contexts matching the historical Wang Dun: in the 仇隟 chapter, the mother explicitly says "王敦昔肆酷汝父" (Wang Dun formerly cruelly treated your father), and in the 汰侈 chapter, 王敦 appears alongside 石崇 in a well-known anecdote. The Liu annotation also references 王敦 in the context of 晉陽秋. All evidence converges on the same historical person, and there is no contradicting evidence suggesting a different individual.

The target surface 王敦 in story 05-fangzheng-028 refers to Wang Dun (王敦), the well-known Eastern Jin general and warlord. The main text explicitly describes him as the brother of 王含 (Wang Han), and states that 何充 was his 主簿 (chief clerk). The Liu annotation also refers to 王敦 as 中宗相州刺史 and mentions him in connection with 司馬丞. Additional evidence from other stories (36-chouxi-003, 30-taichi-010) consistently identifies 王敦 as the same historical figure — the Grand General (大將軍) who killed 司馬愍王 and who studied with 石崇. The context in this story — protecting his brother 王含 who was governor of 廬江 — matches the known historical Wang Dun. There is no evidence suggesting a different person, and the identification is consistent across multiple independent sources.

The target surface "王敦" in story 27-jiajue-006 refers to the same person as the claimed person 王敦. The main text explicitly states "王敦舉兵圖逆" and "行敦營匝而出" and "敦卧心動", all referring to the same individual. The known local participant is 王敦 (person-011), surfaced as 王大將軍, and the story context clearly identifies this as the rebel general 王敦 who was being spied on by 晉明帝. The additional evidence from story 36-chouxi-003 also explicitly refers to "王敦昔肆酷汝父" identifying the same historical figure, and story 30-taichi-010 mentions 王敦 in the same context. All evidence consistently points to the same historical person 王敦, the Eastern Jin general. There is no contradicting evidence suggesting a different person.
